_note: Singapore planning parameters. Each entry names its official source and the date it was confirmed. Entries with "verified_on": null were entered from general knowledge and have NOT been confirmed against the source - check them before any output reaches a client. Do not add a parameter without a source.

income_tax_brackets_resident_individual.description: Progressive resident individual income tax brackets, chargeable income basis.

cpf_ordinary_wage_ceiling_monthly.description: Monthly Ordinary Wage ceiling for CPF contributions.

cpf_contribution_rates_percent.description: Total, employer and employee CPF contribution rates by age band for citizens and PRs (third year onwards) with monthly wages above $750.
cpf_contribution_rates_percent.note: Rates for senior workers are scheduled to rise again from 1 January 2027.

cpf_annual_salary_ceiling.description: Annual Salary Ceiling. The Additional Wage ceiling for a year equals this figure less the Ordinary Wages already subject to CPF that year.

cpf_interest_rates_percent.description: Annual interest credited to each CPF account, before the additional interest tiers.
cpf_interest_rates_percent.note: Extra interest is paid on the first tranche of combined balances, with a further tier from age 55. Floor rates have been held for several years but the additional tiers change.

srs_contribution_cap_citizen_pr.description: Annual SRS contribution cap for Singapore citizens and permanent residents. Contributions up to the cap are tax-relieving.

srs_contribution_cap_foreigner.description: Annual SRS contribution cap for foreigners.

srs_taxable_fraction_on_qualifying_withd.description: Fraction of an SRS withdrawal that is taxable when taken from the statutory retirement age onwards.

srs_withdrawal_window_years.description: Number of years over which SRS withdrawals can be spread, starting at the statutory retirement age.

srs_early_withdrawal_penalty_percent.description: Penalty on the amount withdrawn from SRS before the statutory retirement age. The withdrawn amount is also fully taxable.

statutory_retirement_age.description: Statutory retirement age, which sets the earliest date for penalty-free SRS withdrawal.
statutory_retirement_age.note: Scheduled to increase to 64 from 1 July 2026 and to 65 from 2030. Confirm which applies to the plan year.

cpf_topup_relief_cap_self.description: Maximum tax relief for cash top-ups to the client's own CPF Retirement Account or Special Account.

cpf_topup_relief_cap_family.description: Maximum tax relief for cash top-ups to the CPF account of a spouse, parent, or sibling who meets the eligibility conditions.

insurance_relief_cap_self.description: Maximum tax relief for life insurance premiums paid by the client, including a sub-limit for premiums on MediSave-approved plans.

earned_income_relief.description: Automatic relief on earned income, scaled by age band.
